name: Jump Rope
instruction: Create a 3D model of a jump rope. The rope should be long enough for an adult to use, with handles on both ends.

Shape accuracy: The object in the images is a jump rope.
The jump rope consists of a long, flexible rope.
There are handles at both ends of the rope.
Color representation: The color set in the script is reasonable for the object.
Size: The size set in the script is reasonable for the object.
Proportion: The length of the rope is proportionate to the length of the handles.
The handles are proportionate to the thickness of the rope.
Texture and surface detail: The texture and surface detail set in the script is reasonable for the object.

Three-dimensional spatial awareness: The handles are positioned correctly at both ends of the rope.
The rope hangs naturally when not in use.
The rope should have a slight curve when laid flat.
Object distance and contact: There is no overlap between the handles and the rope.
The handles are securely attached to the ends of the rope.

Instruction execution accuracy: All specified attributes are accurately represented.
The model reflects the requirement for adult use.
